verdict.rationale: Insomnia's import docs list OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 and Swagger as supported import formats. They also describe a concrete workflow (UI → Import → File/Clipboard/URL) for bringing an OpenAPI spec into Insomnia, alongside spec design and editing. missing for 10: explicit documentation that importing a spec generates individual requests and collections (this is only implied), and independent or hands-on corroboration of import quality.
